gloss: dismissal from office; removal from a government post

definitions.gloss: dismissal from office; removal from a government post
definitions.explanation: The formal removal of a government official from their position. A term used in historical, legal, and bureaucratic contexts, particularly regarding the Japanese civil service and historical officialdom.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大臣|だいじん}→大臣：03417_daijin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{免官|めんかん}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The minister was removed from office.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不祥事|ふしょうじ}→不祥事：14981_fushouji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こした→起こす：01234_okosu⟧⟦{官僚|かんりょう}→官僚：02780_kanryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{免官|めんかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: The bureaucrat who caused the scandal received a dismissal from office.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明治|めいじ}{時代|じだい}→明治時代：28080_meijijidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{免官|めんかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{天皇|てんのう}→天皇：04546_tennou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{勅令|ちょくれい}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: During the Meiji era, dismissals from office were carried out by imperial decree.

notes:
Composed of {免|めん} (dismiss, release from) and {官|かん} (government official, office). A formal term from the vocabulary of government administration, often encountered in historical texts about Japanese government and the civil service.

The term pairs with {任官|にんかん} (appointment to office) as its opposite. In modern Japan, the process is governed by the {国家公務員法|こっかこうむいんほう} (National Public Service Act), though the word {免官|めんかん} itself has a somewhat historical flavor. In contemporary usage, ⟦{免職|めんしょく}→免職：18807_menshoku⟧ (dismissal from a position) is more common for disciplinary removals.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {免官|めんかん}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be dismissed from office
- {免官|めんかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧: disciplinary dismissal
- {免官|めんかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{命|めい}じる→命じる：02309_meijiru⟧: to order a dismissal
- ⟦{懲戒|ちょうかい}→懲戒：09469_choukai⟧{免官|めんかん}: disciplinary dismissal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{免職|めんしょく}→免職：18807_menshoku⟧: dismissal from a position — more commonly used in modern administrative language; applies to any job position, not just government posts
- ⟦{罷免|ひめん}→罷免：29397_himen⟧: removal from office — stronger term implying forced removal, often used for high-ranking officials
- ⟦{解任|かいにん}→解任：17173_kainin⟧: dismissal, removal — used more broadly for any official position including corporate roles
- {任官|にんかん}: appointment to office — the opposite action
